meta.name: lsp
meta.description: Use when Codex needs language-server diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, or rename safety checks in the current workspace.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在编辑器中获取代码诊断、定义跳转和引用查找
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在代码编辑器中快速定位定义、引用或检查重命名安全
copy.tagline_en: Get language diagnostics, definitions, references, and rename safety in your editor
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick access to definitions, references, and rename safety in your code editor

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能借助语言服务器检查代码错误与警告,定位函数或变量的定义,查找使用位置,并判断或执行安全的重命名操作。
howto.when: 当需要语言服务器的诊断、定义、引用等检查时触发。

say.text: 帮我看看这个文件里有哪些错误和警告。
say.note: 运行 LSP 诊断检查。

say.text: 找到 foo 函数的定义在哪里。
把变量 bar 改名为 baz,先检查安不安全。
say.note: 进行重命名安全性检查并应用。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use the language server to check code errors and warnings, locate definitions of functions or variables, find their usages, and validate or perform safe renames.
howto.when_en: Triggers when language-server diagnostics, definitions, references, or similar checks are needed.

say_en.text: Check for errors and warnings in this file.
Find where the function foo is defined.
Rename variable bar to baz, check if it's safe first.
